 "data": "flowchart TD
 A[\"main.go: create GOREST app\"] --> B[\"Register logger, Redis, database, server\"]
 B --> C[\"Register User, Department, Order routers\"]
 C --> D{\"Startup services succeed?\"}
 D -- \"No\" --> E[\"Startup fails; inspect configuration and logs\"]
 D -- \"Yes\" --> F[\"Serve HTTP requests\"]
 F --> Q{\"SIGINT or SIGTERM received?\"}
 Q -- \"No\" --> F
 Q -- \"Yes\" --> R[\"app.Close(): shut down application services\"]
 F --> G[\"Server middleware<br/>recover, request ID, compression,<br/>CORS, helmet, rate limiter\"]
 G --> H[\"Router matches method and path\"]
 H --> I[\"Handler parses path, query, and JSON\"]
 I --> J[\"Library validates and applies app rules\"]
 J --> K[\"Model builds ORM or native query\"]
 K --> L[\"GOREST database API / configured driver\"]
 L --> M{\"Database operation succeeds?\"}
 M -- \"Yes\" --> N[\"Handler maps data with app/view<br/>and builds JSON response\"]
 N --> O[\"HTTP response\"]
 O --> F
 I -. \"input or validation error\" .-> P[\"Handler logs error and sends error response\"]
 J -. \"application or model error\" .-> P
 M -- \"No\" --> P
 P --> O",
 "config": null
